page_title: DOR 0-1 STU | Dortmund v Stuttgart 06/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+10' A pass by Jadon Sancho (Dortmund) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
90+8' Alexander Nubel makes a brilliant save! Jadon Sancho (Dortmund) met a rebound outside the box and attempted to beat the keeper low into the middle of the goal.

90+8' Sebastien Haller (Dortmund) outjumps the defence to meet the resulting corner and heads the ball low to the middle of the goal. The long-range header is not powerful enough, and the keeper comfortably makes a save.
90+7' Jadon Sancho (Dortmund) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
90+7' CHANCE! Serhou Guirassy (VfB Stuttgart) picks up a perfect pass inside the box, makes himself some space for a shot, but his effort goes just over the crossbar.
90+5' The opposition can't get near Jadon Sancho (Dortmund), who finally takes a shot inside the box. The effort looks goalbound but veers just wide of the left post at the last second.
90+5' Jadon Sancho (Dortmund) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
90+4' Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players. Dortmund will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
90+2' Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players.
90' There will be a minimum of 9 min. of added time.
90' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Deniz Undav walks off the pitch to be replaced by Pascal Stenzel (VfB Stuttgart).
86' Sebastian Hoeness has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Mahmoud Dahoud (VfB Stuttgart) replacing Enzo Millot.
85' It will be a substitution. Silas (VfB Stuttgart) is ready to enter the pitch as Jamie Leweling walks off.
85' Yellow card! It's like Alexander Nubel (VfB Stuttgart) was asking for a caution with his behaviour. Matthias Jollenbeck agrees and books him.
84' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Jadon Sancho (Dortmund), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
83' Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball. The linesman makes the right call and Dortmund will have a corner.
81' Here is a change. Julian Ryerson is going off and Edin Terzic gives the last tactical orders to Marco Reus (Dortmund).
81' Substitution. Sebastien Haller (Dortmund) on for Niclas Fullkrug.
81' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Ian Maatsen as he is replaced by Youssoufa Moukoko (Dortmund).
81' The rebound finds Nico Schlotterbeck (Dortmund) in space inside the box, but his shot flies high over the bar. That was a promising chance!
81' Mats Hummels (Dortmund) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the corner, but his fine header towards the bottom left corner is brilliantly saved by the diving goalkeeper.
81' Jadon Sancho (Dortmund) will deliver the corner kick.
80' Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear. Dortmund force a corner. They send men into the box.
75' The attendance is 81365.
72' Here comes a substitution. Jamie Bynoe-Gittens (Dortmund) is brought on as a substitute for Marcel Sabitzer.
72' Atakan Karazor (VfB Stuttgart) sees a yellow! His tackle wasn't that harsh, but he probably talked himself into Matthias Jollenbeck's book.
72' Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund) sees a yellow card from Matthias Jollenbeck after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
70' Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) is well placed to meet a cross and sends a difficult header directed into the roof of the net, but the goalkeeper reacts well to stop his effort.
68' Sebastian Hoeness decides to make a substitution. Chris Fuhrich will be replaced by Woo-Yeong Jeong (VfB Stuttgart).
65' Substitution. Felix Nmecha (Dortmund) in, Julian Brandt out.
65' 0 - 1 Goal - 0:1! Serhou Guirassy (VfB Stuttgart) gets a shot away from the edge of the box and scores into the top right corner. Jamie Leweling provided an assist for the goal.
62' The ball goes out of play. Stuttgart are awarded a corner kick.

61' Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) picks up the ball and goes on a great solo run. He decides to shoot from mid-range but his attempt is comfortably blocked by a defender. The referee blows his whistle, Stuttgart are awarded a corner kick.
61' Niclas Fullkrug (Dortmund) plants a goal-bound header towards the top of the net after a nice cross inside the box, but one of the defenders manages to deflect it away.
58' The linesman signals that Jadon Sancho (Dortmund) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
55' The foul by Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund) was seen by Matthias Jollenbeck who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
54' Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Matthias Jollenbeck who sees an offensive foul.
52' Jadon Sancho (Dortmund) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
50' Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) connects with a cross and has an effort on goal from the edge of the box, but his attempt goes well wide of the left post.

49' Nico Schlotterbeck (Dortmund) timed his run perfectly to connect with the resulting corner kick, but his finish from around the penalty spot was rather poor as it went well wide of the right post.
49' Corner kick. Jadon Sancho (Dortmund) is ready to send the ball into the box.

49' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Julian Brandt (Dortmund), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Dortmund.
48' Matthias Jollenbeck interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart).
48' Good defending. Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart) tries to find Serhou Guirassy inside the box, but the pass is cut out.
46' Sebastian Hoeness makes a switch. Leonidas Stergiou is coming on in place of Josha Vagnoman (VfB Stuttgart) at the start of the second period.
46' The second half has just started.
45+6' The match has reached half-time.
45+1' A yellow card for a tackle by Julian Brandt (Dortmund). Matthias Jollenbeck doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
45' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
45' Matthias Jollenbeck blows his whistle and it's Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
45' Atakan Karazor (VfB Stuttgart) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.
42' The corner is swung in and Niclas Fullkrug (Dortmund) leaps above the defence only to send his header a whisker wide of the right post from close in.
41' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
41' Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) attempts to find one of his teammates with a fine lofted pass, but the defence reacts well to intercept the effort. Good work from Dortmund as they win a corner.
36' Nico Schlotterbeck (Dortmund) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball.
32' The corner is swung in but Dortmund can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

31' Alexander Nubel pulls off a great save to deny Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund) after receiving a precise defence-splitting pass. The effort is headed for the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper dives superbly to stop it. Definitely the best save of this match so far!
26' Today's referee Matthias Jollenbeck rightly decides to book Enzo Millot (VfB Stuttgart) for his harsh tackle.
25' Serhou Guirassy (VfB Stuttgart) latches on to a superb cross into the box and plants a header well wide of the right post.
18' A spell of possession for Stuttgart in an attempt to control the game.
15' Niclas Fullkrug (Dortmund) towers above the defence but fails to trouble the keeper, heading the corner kick well wide of the left post from close range.
14' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.

14' Emre Can (Dortmund) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the bottom right corner, but Alexander Nubel easily deals with the threat. Dortmund force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
9' The foul by Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Matthias Jollenbeck.
9' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
6' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Dortmund for a penalty. Play continues.
2' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) prepares to take a corner kick.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Stuttgart will kick-off.
Matthias Jollenbeck will officiate today.
